name: ombulabs-ai
description: Rails upgrade tooling by OmbuLabs, based on FastRuby.io methodology

plugins.name: dual-boot
plugins.description: Dual-boot setup with next_rails gem for running two Rails/Ruby versions simultaneously

plugins.name: rails-load-defaults
plugins.description: Align Rails load_defaults across versions with safe, incremental config changes

plugins.name: rails-upgrade
plugins.description: Plan and execute Rails version upgrades following FastRuby.io methodology

plugins.name: upgrade-cleanup
plugins.description: Clean up after (or abandon) a Rails upgrade. Asks whether to keep the next or the current version, then drops NextRails branches and retires dual-boot scaffolding accordingly.
